0022600183.text: The Trail Blazers, 5-1 overall and 4-0 on the road, enter this seventh game of their season first in the Northwest and third in the West on a two-game winning streak, though Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery) are both out. The Phoenix Suns are 1-4, have lost three straight, and sit 12th in the West and third in the Pacific, 3.5 games back, with Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery), and Rasheer Fleming (ankle, sprain) all unavailable. Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 124-83 win in Portland on October 21, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost 1-2 to Phoenix.
